name: led-xinglight-2835-blue
description: XINGLIGHT XL-2835UBC-02 2835 blue LED, 460 nm dominant (465 nm peak), 60 mA max continuous, 200 mW, Vf 3.4 V max (3.2 typ), 120 deg, 1.75 cd (LCSC C2843871). Note 60 mA is the ABSOLUTE MAXIMUM, flat only to ~30 C ambient: run it PWM'd, not DC

vf_trim.description: forward-voltage offset in volts for this LED (bin/part spread); the series source V<ref>_trim also measures the LED current: probe i(V<ref>_trim)
